title: Anti-Inflammatory Effects of Pingyin Rose Essential Oil in LPS-Induced HaCaT Cells: An in Vitro and in Silico Study.
authors: Song, Jingyi; Raka, Rifat Nowshin; Zhang, Zhongwei; Xiao, Junsong; Huang, Mingquan; Wu, Hua
one_liner_zh: 研究平阴玫瑰精油在LPS诱导HaCaT细胞中的抗炎作用，涉及分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Pingyin rose essential oil (PREO) is extracted from fresh petals exclusively cultivated in Shandong Province. This PREO has been used in traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) for decades to treat skin issues like excessive oxidative stress and inflammation. The purpose of this study was to assess the impact of PREO on the inflammatory pathway in HaCaT cells produced by LPS. In vitro methods were used to ascertain the expression of inflammatory proteins, and network pharmacological analysis was employed to predict the signaling pathway. According to our findings, PREO significantly reduced LPS-induced oxidative stress, decreasing nitric oxide (NO) and reactive oxygen species (ROS) production by 42% and 38%, respectively, and malondialdehyde (MDA) levels by 35%, while enhancing superoxide dismutase (SOD) activity by 28% (p < 0.01). PREO treatment (0.1%, 18 h) markedly suppressed pro-inflammatory cytokines, with mRNA levels of TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, IL-6, and IL-8 reduced by 52%, 47%, 45%, and 40%, respectively. Mechanistically, PREO inhibited the TLR4-NF-kappaB pathway, downregulating MyD88 and TRIF expression by 60% and 55%, and reducing NF-kappaB p65 and IkappaB-alpha phosphorylation by 50% and 48%. Network pharmacology and molecular docking identified Citronellol (54.37% of PREO) as the major bioactive component, exhibiting strong binding affinities with IKKbeta (-5.7 kcal/moL) and MyD88 (-4.5 kcal/moL). This research, distinct from previous investigations on Rosa rugosa polyphenols, provides a novel mechanistic link between PREO's traditional use and its observed anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects in keratinocytes, specifically through inhibition of the TLR4-NF-kappaB pathway.
abstract_zh: 平阴玫瑰精油（PREO）是从山东省独有栽培的新鲜花瓣中提取的。该PREO已在传统中药（TCM）中应用数十年，用于治疗皮肤问题，如过度氧化应激和炎症。本研究旨在评估PREO对脂多糖（LPS）诱导的HaCaT细胞炎症通路的影响。采用体外方法测定炎症蛋白的表达，并运用网络药理学分析预测信号通路。我们的研究结果显示，PREO显著减轻了LPS诱导的氧化应激，使一氧化氮（NO）和活性氧（ROS）的产生分别降低42%和38%，丙二醛（MDA）水平降低35%，同时使超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）活性增强28%（p < 0.01）。PREO处理（0.1%，18小时）显著抑制了促炎细胞因子，其中TNF-α、IL-1β、IL-6和IL-8的mRNA水平分别降低52%、47%、45%和40%。机制上，PREO抑制了TLR4-NF-κB通路，使MyD88和TRIF表达下调60%和55%，并减少NF-κB p65和IκB-α磷酸化50%和48%。网络药理学和分子对接鉴定出香茅醇（占PREO的54.37%）为主要生物活性成分，与IKKβ（-5.7 kcal/mol）和MyD88（-4.5 kcal/mol）表现出强结合亲和力。本研究不同于以往关于玫瑰多酚的探讨，为PREO的传统用途与其在角质形成细胞中观察到的抗炎和抗氧化作用之间提供了新的机制联系，具体通过抑制TLR4-NF-κB通路实现。
